class.name: NetwAdmissionConfig
class.brief_description: Settings for a session's admission handler.
class.description:
The server receives a [NetwJoinRequest] and waits for the handler to return [constant @GlobalScope.OK] before admitting its [NetwPlayer]. The handler may [code]await[/code]. Each [NetwAccountProvider] accepted here proves one kind of account first. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_admission(admit).accept(PasscodeAccount.new())
func admit(request: NetwJoinRequest) -> Error: return OK if request.account else ERR_UNAUTHORIZED [/codeblock]

method.name: accept
method.description: Adds [param provider] to the accounts a joining player proves, in preference order. Accept the same providers in the same order on every peer. A config with no provider sends no challenge.
